basic_details.job_title: AYCL Dy. Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Andrew Yule & Company Limited (AYCL), a Government of India Enterprise, has invited online applications for one Dy. Engineer (Tech. - Sales & Marketing) post on the permanent roll in its Electrical Division, Chennai. The pay scale is S3 – 28000 – 89050, the essential qualification is a diploma in a listed engineering branch with minimum 4 years' post-qualification experience, and the maximum age is 40 years. Online applications open on 13 November 2026 and the last date is 3 December 2026, on www.andrewyule.com.

how_to_apply: Go to the Company website www.andrewyule.com and open career opportunity, then online submission of application.
Select Advt. No. 2026/14 and click Apply Now. No other mode of submission is allowed.

Before applying, have a PAN / Aadhaar card, an active email ID and a mobile phone number. The email ID and mobile number must remain valid for at least twelve months for future communication, including issue of call letters.
Keep a scanned copy of your latest passport size photograph in JPG/JPEG format, not exceeding 1 MB, ready for uploading.

AYCL is not responsible if candidates fill in their details wrongly and the application is rejected as a result. Candidates working with Govt. Departments, statutory corporations or Public Sector Enterprises should apply strictly through proper channel.
Latest passport size photograph (JPG/JPEG, up to 1 MB).
Original documents in support of qualification, experience and age, to be produced at the time of interview.
No Objection Certificate for candidates of Govt. Departments, statutory corporations or Public Sector Enterprises. It may also be produced before the interview if not enclosed with the application.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications, applications not in the prescribed format, and illegible applications will be summarily rejected without reasons. Multiple applications from the same person against a post are not permitted and are liable to be rejected. Candidates from Govt. Departments, statutory corporations or PSEs who cannot produce a No Objection Certificate at the interview will not be allowed to appear. Misrepresentation or falsification of facts, or misconduct, at any stage of selection will lead to cancellation of candidature without notice. Selected candidates may be transferred and placed anywhere in India; transfer is a service condition. The number of vacancies is indicative. The Company may increase or decrease it on need basis at any time. The Company may cancel the entire recruitment process at any time, and may reject all or any applications, without assigning reasons. A panel may be drawn from this recruitment and used to fill vacancies arising later if needed. Any update or corrigendum will be posted only on www.andrewyule.com. Any dispute is under the legal jurisdiction of Kolkata (West Bengal) only.

rows.details: Andrew Yule & Company Limited (A Government of India Enterprise)
Dy. Engineer (Tech. - Sales & Marketing), Grade S3

content_sections.heading: About AYCL
content_sections.text: Andrew Yule & Company Limited is based at 8, Dr.Rajendra Prasad Sarani, Kolkata-700 001. According to the notice, it manufactures, sells and services industrial products such as transformers and industrial fans, and has fifteen tea gardens under its control. It became a Government of India Enterprise in 1979 and has three operating divisions (Engineering, Electrical and Tea) and one service division, the General Division.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details before applying.

rows.post: Dy. Engineer (Tech. - Sales & Marketing), S3 (1 post)
rows.essential_qualification: Diploma in Mechanical / Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Electrical & Instrumentation Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Production Engineering from a reputed Institution.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post is on the Permanent roll in the scale S3 – 28000 – 89050. Apart from basic pay, it carries Dearness Allowance (IDA pattern), medical reimbursement, Leave Travel Concession, leave, and conveyance and food allowance/lunch in accordance with Company policy. Encashment of Privilege Leave applies, and coverage under contributory Provident Fund and Gratuity as per rule is also applicable. The notice adds that circumstances may warrant selecting an incumbent at a grade one step below.

content_sections.heading: AYCL Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: To assist in the preparation and submission of tenders. To assist the HOD – Sales & Marketing in the execution of contracts. To carry out customer service activities at the site. To process invoices and maintain other related documents. To coordinate with transporters and logistics service providers. To make complete arrangements for dispatch of materials.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AYCL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to the Company website www.andrewyule.com and open career opportunity, then online submission of application. Select Advt. No. 2026/14 and click Apply Now. No other mode of submission is allowed. Before applying, have a PAN / Aadhaar card, an active email ID and a mobile phone number. The email ID and mobile number must remain valid for at least twelve months for future communication, including issue of call letters. Keep a scanned copy of your latest passport size photograph in JPG/JPEG format, not exceeding 1 MB, ready for uploading. Send any query to [email protected] . AYCL is not responsible if candidates fill in their details wrongly and the application is rejected as a result. Candidates working with Govt. Departments, statutory corporations or Public Sector Enterprises should apply strictly through proper channel. PAN / Aadhaar card. Latest passport size photograph (JPG/JPEG, up to 1 MB). Original documents in support of qualification, experience and age, to be produced at the time of interview. No Objection Certificate for candidates of Govt. Departments, statutory corporations or Public Sector Enterprises. It may also be produced before the interview if not enclosed with the application.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice says selection will be through interview or any other method as decided by the Management. The Company reserves the right to shortlist candidates based on parameters it decides, and no clarification on this will be entertained at any stage. Meeting the eligibility criteria or submitting an application gives no right to shortlisting, an interview or employment. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice. Candidates will not be provided TA/DA for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AYCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 post, Dy. Engineer (Tech. - Sales & Marketing), S3, in the Electrical Division (Chennai). The notice says the number of vacancies is indicative and may be increased or decreased.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the AYCL Dy. Engineer post?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of online application is 3 December 2026. Applications open on 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the AYCL Dy. Engineer post?
faq.answer: A diploma in Mechanical / Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Electrical & Instrumentation Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering or Production Engineering from a reputed Institution, plus minimum 4 years post qualification experience in relevant field/job.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for AYCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 40 years, counted as on the date of publishing of the advertisement. Age relaxation is as per Government norms for the said categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the AYCL Dy. Engineer post?
faq.answer: The scale is S3 – 28000 – 89050. DA (IDA pattern), medical reimbursement, Leave Travel Concession, conveyance and food allowance/lunch, Provident Fund and Gratuity apply as per Company policy and rules.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for AYCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online only, through www.andrewyule.com -> career opportunity -> online submission of application -> Advt. No. 2026/14 -> Apply Now. No other mode of application is allowed.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection will be through interview or any other method decided by the Management. The Company may shortlist candidates on parameters it decides.

faq.question: Q8. Is the AYCL Dy. Engineer post permanent?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice invites applications for the post on the Permanent roll in the Electrical Division (Chennai).

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says candidates will not be provided TA/DA for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one position?
faq.answer: No. A candidate can apply for only one position against this advertisement, and multiple applications from the same person for a post are liable to be rejected.
